workflow: A worker begins attaching and publishes its execution-state record to a shared registry before all identity fields are initialized.
A concurrent observer traverses the registry and reads the worker’s identity field while the attaching worker writes it.
The unsynchronized read and write form a data race, producing inconsistent state or sanitizer-reported failure instead of safe observation.
The failure affects ordinary concurrent inspection until publication is delayed or the field access is synchronized.
summary: Concurrent observation of partially initialized published state
decision_reason: The underlying workflow is materially the same as concurrent isolated contexts racing on shared process-wide state: one execution context publishes or initializes shared metadata while another reads it without sufficient synchronization. The specific identity field and registry details are symptoms,
